Mid/Senior Full Stack Developer (Java / Frontend) 
 A global financial services and insurance organization is looking for a Mid/Senior Full Stack Developer to build high-performing, scalable enterprise systems and innovative architectural solutions.
 Role Overview: 
 Work Model: Hybrid (3 days office / 2 days remote)
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Key Responsibilities: 
Design, implement, test, and deploy scalable, robust business features and backend systems using Java.
Develop clean, user-friendly interfaces using modern frontend technologies.
Collaborate within cross-functional Agile teams to estimate and solve complex technical challenges.
Monitor, profile, and optimize application performance, security, and DevSecOps practices.
Document workflows, technical specifications, and process architectures to maintain clarity and continuity.
 Requirements: 
 Core Technical Experience: Mid-to-senior experience in OOP, Java ecosystem (Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JHipster, Maven/Gradle), API design, and database integration (SQL/PostgreSQL, NoSQL/MongoDB).
 Frontend Experience: Modern frontend experience using JavaScript; Angular expertise is highly desired.
 Cloud & DevOps: Practical experience with Azure Cloud services, Docker, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps tools/frameworks.
 Education & Languages: Degree in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent field; professional fluency in English (written and spoken).
 Nice to Have: 
Knowledge of French.
Exposure to Low-Code / No-Code development platforms.
Interest in AI foundations or practical business process applications.
 What’s Offered: 
Flexible hybrid working culture (3 days office / 2 days remote).
Direct impact on high-scale global financial and risk management software architectures.
Collaborative culture based on innovation, continuous learning, and state-of-the-art tech adoption.
 Interested in joining the team? 
 Apply directly to this post or send your CV to mara@brainsource.io .
